verdict.rationale: Lago's docs show a usage-event ingestion pipeline via POST /api/v1/events, with an AI-request pricing example in the repo. They also document deduplication so that an event arriving twice is billed once, which covers idempotent ingestion. However, nothing in the pack shows backdated events or high-volume throughput, so two qualifiers of the story are unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented backdating/historical-timestamp support, evidence of high-volume or batch ingestion at scale, independent hands-on corroboration of the ingestion pipeline.
